_comment: Public pages rendered by the React app. Used by src/constants/seo.js (titles, canonicals at runtime) and by marketing/build-static.js (per-route HTML for crawlers that don't run JavaScript). Keep summaries factual: they must match the page.

pages.title: Use Your Own Gemini API Key for AI Resume Writing | Presmistique
pages.description: Connect your own free Google Gemini API key to Presmistique and use AI resume writing, rewriting and ATS analysis without buying tokens.
pages.h1: Use your own Gemini API key
pages.nav: Use your own Gemini API key
summary: Add your own Google Gemini API key to your Presmistique profile and the AI features run on your key instead of using Presmistique tokens.
Google offers a free tier for Gemini API keys. Its daily request limits comfortably cover normal resume work.
points: Create a key in Google AI Studio.
In Presmistique, open your profile, paste the key and save.
Your key is stored encrypted and used only to call the Gemini API for you.
Remove the key from your profile at any time; your existing tokens are kept.

pages.title: Contact Us | Presmistique
pages.description: Questions about your resume, tokens or payments? Contact the Presmistique AI Resume Builder support team.
summary: Questions about your resume, AI tokens or a payment? Email the support address below or use the contact form on this page. We typically respond within 48 hours.

pages.title: Privacy Policy | Presmistique
pages.description: How Presmistique collects, uses and protects your account details and resume data.
summary: How Presmistique collects, uses and protects your account details and resume data. The full policy loads on this page.
points: We collect what you give us: account details, resume content and support messages. Payments are handled by Razorpay; we don't see card or bank details.
We don't sell personal information.
Text needed for an AI feature you use is sent to Google's Gemini API to produce the result.
Data is shared only with the providers needed to run the service: Google (Gemini, sign-in), LinkedIn (sign-in), Razorpay, Cloudflare and our email provider.
You can update your information and delete your account from your profile.

pages.title: Terms and Conditions | Presmistique
pages.description: The terms that apply when you use the Presmistique AI Resume Builder, AI tokens and paid token packs.
summary: The terms that apply when you use the Presmistique AI Resume Builder, AI tokens and paid token packs. The full terms load on this page.
points: Building, editing and downloading resumes is free.
Every AI action uses 1 token. New users receive 5 free tokens; more can be bought through Razorpay. Tokens never expire.
You keep ownership of the content you create.
AI suggestions can be inaccurate; review everything before you use it.

pages.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy | Presmistique
pages.description: When Presmistique refunds token-pack payments, and how to raise a refund request.
summary: How tokens, cancellations and payment problems are handled. The full policy loads on this page.
points: There are no subscriptions, so there is nothing recurring to cancel.
Token purchases are final and tokens never expire.
If an AI action fails because of a technical error, its token is re-credited automatically.
If you were charged twice, or charged without receiving tokens, contact us with your receipt number and registered email.

pages.title: Shipping and Delivery Policy | Presmistique
pages.description: Presmistique sells digital AI tokens. Here is how and when purchased tokens are delivered to your account.
summary: Presmistique is a digital service. Nothing is shipped physically.
points: Templates and tools are available as soon as you register.
Purchased AI tokens are added to your account instantly.
PDF exports are generated instantly and downloaded to your device.
